## Usage note

The project is intended for lawful learning, troubleshooting, automation, and defensive cybersecurity use. A page or tool description does not grant permission to test or access third-party systems.


## Greek localized edition
The complete Greek edition is available under `https://ded-sec.space/el/`. Greek pages use localized titles, descriptions, visible content, structured data, canonical URLs, and reciprocal hreflang annotations. Technical commands, filenames, product names, standards, and code identifiers remain unchanged for accuracy.
